title: Control Flow Divergence Optimization by Exploiting Tensor Cores
problem: Threads within a GPU warp may execute different branches sequentially when encountering conditional statements, resulting in considerable utilization loss and unpredictable execution time. This control flow divergence is a fundamental performance bottleneck in GPU kernel execution.
motivation: Control flow divergence severely impacts GPU utilization and execution time predictability, which are critical performance factors for GPU computing.
method: A branch prediction network is deployed on GPU tensor cores to predict thread execution paths before kernel launch, running in parallel with kernels on CUDA cores. Combined with a thread data reorganization algorithm, this enables efficient divergence mitigation with minimal overhead.
key_novelty: Using tensor cores to implement branch prediction in parallel with the main kernel execution on CUDA cores, enabling low-overhead control flow divergence mitigation.
contributions: Branch prediction network for predicting GPU warp thread execution paths
Exploitation of tensor cores for parallel branch prediction without impacting CUDA core kernels
Thread data reorganization algorithm to complement branch prediction
Control flow divergence mitigation with minimal overhead
